R9.reason: Pocket holes are drilled in 1.5" 2x4 and 2x2 stock (cutList thickness 2 nominal) but no jig thickness setting is stated: search of all steps, summary and description for /jig|setting|thick/i finds nothing; the viewed step images show pocket holes but no jig setting.

evidence.quote: Nail the roof slats into place with 3/4" spacing and a 1" hang off on the two ends.

R14.arithmetic: (a) Roof Beams are 79" long (cutList[8]); 1x4 slats are 3 1/2" wide (§9) with 3/4" spacing, so n per slope: n x 3.5 + (n-1) x 0.75 <= 79 gives n = 18 (18 x 3.5 + 17 x 0.75 = 75.75; 19 x 3.5 + 18 x 0.75 = 80 > 79), i.e. 2 x 18 = 36 slats for two slopes, but cutList[14] has 23x Roof Slats (23 / 2 = 11.5 slats per slope cover about 11.5 x (3.5 + 0.75) = 48.9" of the 79"). Likely, not certain: the plan never states the roof length or that both slopes are slatted (the viewed finished photos show both slopes covered).
R14.reason: Slat count in cut list is well below what the stated spacing and beam length need. (b)-(d): all made parts are installed except Back Ladder Support (R3); hangers, paint and bolts are in materials.

gaps.what: Siding stock vs cut list: cutList[21] needs 3x Back siding 83 1/2" long, which cannot come from a 72" board (83.5 > 72). Total 1x6 parts = 6x12 + 3x55.25 + 9x44 + 3x83.5 = 72 + 165.75 + 396 + 250.5 = 884.25" (+ kerf) against 9 x 72 (materials[4]) + 1 x 72 (materials[5]) = 720". With 96" boards (10 x 96 = 960) it would fit, so the 72" length may be the error.
1x4 stock bought = 7 x 96 = 672"; the only 1x4 rows are cutList[14] 23x Roof Slats at 32" (736") and cutList[13] 1x Back Ladder Support at 17": 736 + 17 = 753" > 672" before kerf.
